new_theorem.statement: For Q=a X0^2+2 X0 b^T Z+Z^T D Z+ell0 X0+ell^T Z+c with a!=0 and independent cap-one original variables, if the exact scalar Schur remainder R(Z) has density cap K, then Q has density cap at most 2 sqrt(2K/|a|). The translated square may be arbitrarily correlated with R through Z.

Scaling the account02/B11 family by two gives remainder cap 6; arbitrary scalar cross coupling through tilde A_b yields ||p||inf<=2 sqrt(6)=4.8989794856 for ||b||<=1/4, with at least three eigenvalues >1 in modulus.

rank_two_control: For centered unit uniforms, p_{2XY}(t)=log(1/(2|t|)) on 0<|t|<1/2. The third direction is used through a product-safe rank-three remainder mechanism; the theorem does not declare the saddle itself bounded.
